div.head: II Cn 22.1a
div.ab: And ofgá man anfealde lade mid anfealdan foraðe ⁊ þryfealde lade mid þryfealdan foraðe.
⁊ ofga man anfealdne lade mid þryfealde forade.
Et inducatur simplex láda (id est purgatio) simplici preiuramento, triplex lada triplici preiuramento.
Ofga mán anfealde láde mid anfealde foraðe ⁊ ðrifealde lade mid ðrifealdan foraðe.

In cases where a simple oath of exculpation is involved, the case shall be begun with a simple oath of accusation, but where a triple oath of exculpation is involved, it shall be begun with a triple oath of accusation.
And a simple process of exculpation is to be set on foot by a simple preliminary oath, and a three-fold process of exculpation by a three-fold preliminary oath.
Und man [Kläger] erzwinge einfache Reinigung durch einfachen Klageeid und dreifache Reinigung durch dreifachen Klageeid.
And let [the plaintiff] compel the single clearing by a single fore-oath, and the threefold clearing by a threefold fore-oath.
div.note: A skips a line (from ‘mid anfealdan’ to ‘þryfealde’).
